charts.title: TOI-5713 b: orbits around TOI-5713
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5713's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5713 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Ghachoui et al. 2024 (2024A&A...690A.263G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GHACHOUI_ET_AL__2024): P 10.441989 d

charts.title: TOI-5713 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-5713 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (23, 49, 76) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 219041246, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 9 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min late; 7-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 3 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
